messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Observed on | Long‑Weekend Span |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Jan 1** (Fri) | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Jan 1–3 |
| **Feb 20** (Fri) | Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK, MB, NB, PE) | Feb 20 | Feb 18–20 |
| **Apr 7** (Fri) | Good Friday | Apr 7 | Apr 7–9 |
| **May 22** (Fri) | Victoria Day | May 20–22 | May 20–22 |
| **Jul 1** (Sat) | Canada Day | Jul 1 (observed on Fri 1) | Jul 1–3 |
| **Sep 4** (Fri) | Labour Day | Sep 4 | Sep 2–4 |
| **Oct 9** (Fri) | Thanksgiving | Oct 7–9 | Oct 7–9 |
| **Nov 11** (Fri) | Remembrance Day | Nov 10–12 | Nov 10–12 |
| **Dec 25** (Mon) | Christmas Day | Dec 23–25 | Dec 23–25 |
| **Dec 26** (Tue) | Boxing Day | Dec 24–26 | Dec 24–26 |

> **Quick note:**  
> - Canada Day fell on a Saturday in 2023, so the holiday was observed on the preceding Friday (Jul 1).  
> - Some holidays (e.g., Family Day) are province‑specific; the dates above cover the provinces that observe it.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
